blocks.text: When it comes to keeping your home comfortable and running smoothly, Rosenberg Plumbing & Air offers trusted HVAC and plumbing services in Universal City, TX. Since 2003, our team has helped families and businesses throughout the area enjoy efficient heating and cooling, along with dependable plumbing solutions tailored to their needs. From carefully diagnosed repairs to complex system replacements, we stand out as the go-to choice for comprehensive home services in Universal City.

Our expertise covers everything from residential HVAC systems to large-scale commercial installations, along with plumbing services that protect your property from leaks, clogs, and water damage. When it’s time to upgrade your AC, schedule a plumbing inspection, or join one of our maintenance programs, you can count on us to deliver truly lasting comfort and peace of mind. Every visit begins with clear communication, respectful care for your home, and a commitment to code-compliant workmanship that stands up to South Texas heat and hard water.
Top HVAC Services in Universal City

Texas weather demands reliable heating and cooling, and our HVAC team is always prepared. At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air, we provide emergency HVAC repairs, scheduled tune-ups, and complete heating and cooling system installations. With NATE-certified technicians and years of industry recognition (including the ACCA Residential Contractor of the Year Award), our customers know they’re getting service that combines expertise with proven results.

We also offer flexible financing options on approved credit and membership in our Comfort Club for year-round savings. Members enjoy benefits like priority scheduling, discounted repair rates, and seasonal tune-ups designed to lower energy costs and lengthen equipment life. And, with around-the-clock availability, we make sure your comfort never takes a backseat. We service all major brands and offer honest recommendations without upselling—our priority is safe, efficient operation and dependable comfort for your household or business.
Trusted Plumbing Services in Universal City

To help you stay ahead of unexpected plumbing issues, we offer a plumbing maintenance program that includes annual water heater flushes, leak detection, and discounts on repairs. By being proactive through ongoing care, you can prolong the life of your plumbing system while minimizing the risk of the damage that can come from hidden leaks and burst pipes. Whether you’re remodeling your bathroom, upgrading your water treatment system, or simply need a quick repair, we’re here to help. If a concern does arise, our team arrives prepared to resolve most issues in one visit, minimizing disruption and preventing secondary damage.
